# telnyx_infringement_claim (Data Source)

An infringement claim against one of the account's display identity records.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `claim_id` (String) The claim.

### Read-Only

- `claim_date` (String) When the claim was filed (set by the claimant's representative at file time).
- `claim_description` (String)
- `claim_type` (String) Category of infringement being claimed.
- `claimant_contact` (String)
- `claimant_name` (String)
- `contest_documents` (Attributes List) Aggregated across all customer contest submissions on this claim. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--contest_documents))
- `contest_history` (Attributes List) Per-round submission audit trail. Each entry records one `POST /infringement_claims/{id}/contest` call (notes, timestamp, document count). Aggregated documents live on `contest_documents`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--contest_history))
- `created_at` (String)
- `dir` (Attributes) Snapshot of the DIR the claim is filed against, embedded for convenience. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dir))
- `dir_id` (String)
- `enterprise_id` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `resolution` (String) Set only when `status` is `resolved`.
- `resolution_date` (String)
- `resolution_notes` (String)
- `status` (String) Lifecycle status. `pending` - newly filed; the DIR is auto-suspended. `contested` - you have submitted contest evidence; awaiting Telnyx review. `resolved` - final.
- `updated_at` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--contest_documents"></a>
### Nested Schema for `contest_documents`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) An optional note describing this document, for example what it proves.
- `document_id` (String) Id returned by the Telnyx Documents API after you upload the file (upload via `POST /v2/documents`; see https://developers.telnyx.com/api/documents).
- `document_type` (String) Type of supporting document. Pick the closest match to what the file actually contains; `other` triggers manual vetting and may slow approval. The matching short_name reference list is at `GET /v2/dir/document_types`.


<a id="nestedatt--contest_history"></a>
### Nested Schema for `contest_history`

Read-Only:

- `document_count` (Number)
- `notes` (String)
- `submitted_at` (String)


<a id="nestedatt--dir"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dir`

Read-Only:

- `display_name` (String)
- `enterprise_id` (String)
- `id` (String)
- `status` (String) DIR lifecycle status. - `draft` - newly created; editable; not yet submitted. - `submitted` / `in_review` - Telnyx is reviewing. - `verified` - approved; phone numbers may be attached. - `rejected` - Telnyx rejected this submission; `rejection_reasons` is populated; customer can edit and resubmit. - `unsuccessful` - system-side error during processing; customer can edit and resubmit. - `suspended` - temporarily disabled (e.g. by an active infringement claim). - `expired` - verification expired; customer must resubmit. - `infringement_claimed` - a trademark/impersonation claim is open against this DIR. - `permanently_rejected` - terminal; cannot be resubmitted. - `delete_requested` - you have requested deletion; the DIR still exists and Telnyx is completing the removal (de-registration and cleanup). A verified DIR keeps serving its branded identity, and keeps billing, until the removal finishes.
